Peru

March 16–24, 2024

Overview — Daily Itinerary — Places to Stay — Vlogs

Overview

A one-week trip to Peru, visiting Machu Picch, one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

I did two birding tours, one in Lima with Gustavo Bautista and one in Cusco with Wild Watch Peru. I also did birding on my own at Machu Picchu and Aguas Calientes.

eBird trip report.
